module: Module 6: Independent Sub-Account Margin, Leverage & Stop-Outs
title: Maximum Leverage Limit on Master Terminal Sizing
precondition: Manager attempts order that would push lowest-leverage sub-account past 1:30 limit.
expected_result: Order clamped or blocked: 'Order exceeds maximum leverage limit for retail sub-accounts in group'.
actual_result: Master terminal sizing clamps max parent order volume to ensure lowest-leverage retail account does not exceed 1:30 cap.
